results.label: thm:main
results.statement: Uniform symmetric signs have singularity probability 2^(-n+o(n)).
conditions: Independent on and above diagonal, including diagonal; n tends to infinity; no effective finite n0 or least-singular-value statement.

results.label: lem:sign-bit
results.statement: Uniform sign singularity equals binary symmetric singularity in dimension n-1.
conditions: n>=2; first-row gauge and Schur complement; not a distribution identity for biased signs.

results.label: lem:principal-rank
results.statement: A symmetric matrix over any field has a nonsingular principal minor of its rank.
conditions: Rank-zero minor has determinant one; not restricted to characteristic different from two.

results.label: lem:corank-tail
results.statement: Binary symmetric corank has the binomial forced-block tail over every field.
conditions: Uniform bits including diagonal; sum(j>=k) binom(m,j)2^(-j(j+1)/2); m in I_N gives superexponential tail beyond N^(3/5).

results.label: lem:corank-reduction
results.statement: Singularity reduces to corank-one mass up to subexponential and superexponential terms.
conditions: Uniform binary model, diagonal flips and bounded preimages; not a rank-one output algorithm.

results.label: lem:column-reduction
results.statement: Corank-one probability is at most N 2^(-N) times the expected admissible-column count.
conditions: S(B) requires z^t B^-1 z in {0,1} and infinity norm of B^-1 z <=1; singular B contributes empty admissible set as defined in framework.

results.label: prop:admissible-potential
results.statement: Typical admissible-column count is bounded by the discriminant potential Psi.
conditions: Fixed precision A>0 before sufficiently large N, m in I_N, nonsingular start; atypical probability 2^(-N f(N)), f tends to infinity.

results.label: prop:path-potential
results.statement: The nonsingular-weighted potential moment is subexponential.
conditions: Size N-1; includes indicator of nonsingularity; no finite sampling algorithm or effective rate.

results.label: lem:lattice-quotient
results.statement: Primitive orthogonal lattice quotients obey covolume and dual formulas.
conditions: Quotient is projected inside the real span; primitive K; preimage determinant identity; all zero ranks use determinant one.

results.label: lem:height-submodularity
results.statement: Rational-subspace height is submodular and bounded-height classes are finite.
conditions: H(U+V)H(U intersect V)<=H(U)H(V); dimensions and cutoff fixed; no efficient enumeration guarantee.

results.label: lem:normal-height
results.statement: Normal dual lattice covolumes equal rational-height ratios with an index factor.
conditions: V subset U rational; arbitrary sublattice determinant >=1/H(U), including deficient rank and rank zero.

results.label: thm:reverse-minkowski
results.statement: All-sublattice determinant bounds control Gaussian mass at scale T/[10(log j+2)].
conditions: Every M subset L must have det M>=T^rank M; rank j>=1 gives mass<=3/2; rank zero mass one; old theorem, not a new result.

results.label: lem:gaussian-count
results.statement: Gaussian mass bounds point counts and scales by at most the dimension power.
conditions: R>=0,s>0,s'>=s; use all-sublattice hypothesis before Reverse Minkowski specialization; rank zero separate.

results.label: lem:det-minimizer
results.statement: A primitive normalized-determinant minimizer leaves a quotient with all-sublattice lower bounds.
conditions: Minimize det(M)/T^rank(M); optional rank <=Delta/log(T0/T) requires all original sublattices >=exp(-Delta)T0^rank; existence is not an algorithm.

results.label: lem:robust-extraction
results.statement: An affine restriction retains entropy while making a cube set robust.
conditions: Nonempty binary set; loss<=rho m; ordered independent-basis lower bound includes rank-zero empty tuple.

results.label: lem:robust-height
results.statement: Short differences of an injective rational affine robust cube image have controlled lattice covolume.
conditions: Fixed D,C0, rho=(loglog N)^(-D); actual image-difference lattice rank r, det<=exp(O(N loglog N)); no bound from diameter alone without robustness.

results.label: thm:low-height-cover
results.statement: Low rational-height spaces admit a subquadratic-bit list up to rank distance.
conditions: Fixed D,A; m<=N; size<=2^(N^2 ell^-A), rank distance<=N ell^-A for H<=exp(N ell^D); not angular distance or practical construction.

results.label: prop:typical-ranks
results.statement: One typical event controls all low-height restrictions and coordinate-projected column ranks.
conditions: Uniform symmetric binary B; rational W and all coordinate sets simultaneously; no nonsingularity required; not uniform sign A reduced mod2.

results.label: cor:inverse-rank
results.statement: The inverse bilinear form loses few ranks on every low-height rational subspace.
conditions: B nonsingular; restriction is a bilinear form, not an injective linear-map restriction; uniform typical event.

results.label: prop:prime-corank
results.statement: One typical event bounds corank modulo every prime by N^(3/5).
conditions: Condition includes real nonsingularity, so only finitely many determinant primes matter; no claim for real singular matrices.

results.label: prop:typical-spectrum
results.statement: Typical binary matrices have few eigenvalues in a shrinking interval around zero.
conditions: Fixed A, C_A=A+6 is allowed; count<=N ell^-A in +/-sqrt(N)ell^-C_A; no nonsingularity and no smallest-singular-value bound.

results.label: lem:discriminant-blocks
results.statement: Perfect symmetric primary pairings split into cyclic blocks and special binary blocks.
conditions: Odd primes cyclic; p=2 also rank-two blocks with even diagonal and odd off-diagonal; Q/Z values.

results.label: lem:primary-coloring
results.statement: Isotropic primary elements admit colors with controlled scaled pairings and color counts.
conditions: h=b3, top blocks exponent>h; C_p<=1+8b1, odd p also <=2^(b2-b3); not total group size.

results.label: lem:colored-image-order
results.statement: Within-color differences have small restricted pairing image.
conditions: H generated by differences; Hom(H,Q/Z), not Hom(G_B,Q/Z); image order<=N^(N J_B).

results.label: lem:pairing-determinant
results.statement: A rational form's nonradical determinant has a one-sided pairing-index lower bound.
conditions: Primitive radical lattice K; orthogonal nonradical space; det >=det(K)^2/[t det(L)^2], one power t rather than t^2; rank-zero convention.

results.label: lem:gated-deletion
results.statement: A nonsingular symmetric bit matrix admits one deletion or a gated two-deletion.
conditions: In the two-deletion case both cross columns are admissible for the same nonsingular start; empty minor included.

results.label: prop:potential-step
results.statement: A width-one or gated width-two extension controls the nonsingular weighted potential moment.
conditions: Typicality only on starting C; endpoint indicator and gate remain inside expectation; fixed precision and conditionally independent uniform fresh bits.

results.label: lem:layer-quotient
results.statement: Quotient by one element removes at most one unit from each primary layer.
conditions: Prefix increments u_t in {0,1}; retained layers form prefixes within each constant-height plateau, not across all layers.

results.label: lem:retention-lattice
results.statement: Specified retained layers force membership in a preselected lattice of known index.
conditions: Nonsingular C, fixed quotient and any positive-layer set E; retention implies membership, not an equivalence; index N^(N q(E)).

results.label: lem:layer-inequality
results.statement: Symmetric nonsingular extensions obey a prime-power kernel prefix inequality.
conditions: Widths h=1 or2; F_B(p,t)<=F_C(p,t)+h t-2 U_t over Z/p^t, not merely fields.

results.label: prop:cube-concentration
results.statement: One typical event bounds every intermediate lattice coset's binary intersection.
conditions: B nonsingular, BZ^m subset K subset Z^m; M_K<=2^[N(1-c(q_K)+ell^-A)]; K may depend on B and other data.

results.label: lem:exact-basis-count
results.statement: Low-height cube affine bases have leading j^2 encoding cost.
conditions: All m in I_N and j from0 to m, fixed C,C'; upper count 2^[j^2+o(N^2 ell^-C')]; not a feasible enumeration runtime.

results.label: prop:witness-pricing
results.statement: Robust direct-sum witnesses impose an entropy-versus-coordinate constraint.
conditions: h<=3/eta, rho=eta^3; W_i form a direct sum and S_i-S_i subset K; same coordinate D with |D|=xN<=tN and small M_K(D) is necessary.

results.label: prop:certificate-pricing
results.statement: Outcome classes price at most two plateau-category retention certificates.
conditions: Exposed C and quotient first; tested column stays conditionally uniform; classes fixed before representatives or target weights; probability conditioned only on exposed information, not marks.

results.label: prop:retention-cost
results.statement: Retained-layer weight at least sigma has conditional cost at most 2^(-N sigma/2).
conditions: Typical nonsingular start, widths1/2; preceding column may be exposed; no destination nonsingularity needed.

results.label: lem:budget-optimization
results.statement: An explicit scalar dual budget pays the discriminant potential increment.
conditions: Nonnegative g,v0,a0,u; 2g+3a0+u<=1/2 and g+v0+2a0+2u<=1/2; beta=7/5; analytic argument, not numerical optimization.

results.label: lem:tail-recursion
results.statement: High-layer excess at an extension is bounded by older excess plus retained weights.
conditions: Nonsingular endpoints, width h=1/2 and integer s>=h; W_s(B)<=W_(s+h)(C)+2 retained weight above s+1-h.

results.label: lem:heavy-retention-cost
results.statement: Heavy retained layers have a conditional exponential tail without typicality.
conditions: Fixed nonsingular C and quotient, tested uniform bits; eta fixed, eta/(100 log N)<=q<=1/2; probability<=2^(-3qN/5); preceding column allowed only if fresh uniformity remains.

results.label: thm:main
results.statement: Fixed biased symmetric signs have exponential singularity base p^2+(1-p)^2.
conditions: Each fixed p in (0,1) excluding1/2 before n tends to infinity; no uniform p(n) result or effective finite threshold.

results.label: lem:corank-reduction
results.statement: Biased sign singularity reduces to corank-one mass with subexponential loss.
conditions: Diagonal flips have a p-dependent likelihood ratio as well as preimage cost; p fixed; tail 2^(-Omega_p(n^(6/5))).

results.label: lem:compressible
results.statement: A sparse-approximable normalized kernel tail has mass below the target exponent.
conditions: For every epsilon choose fixed lambda,delta then large n; normalized off-anchor tail; exponent -d_*+epsilon; not absence of all sparse vectors deterministically.

results.label: lem:anchor-congruence
results.statement: Conditioning an anchor row produces independent p-or-b bits with rank-two mean and preserved nullity.
conditions: N=n-1; b=1-p; sign changes of normalized kernel tail; not uniform bit law or independent full matrix rows.

results.label: prop:column-bound
results.statement: Large admissible-column sets are exponentially rare at twice the maximum-atom exponent.
conditions: m=N-1 only, fixed L0>=1 and sufficiently small fixed e0; probability<=2^[-N(2a-10e0)]; S_L0 uses l2 inverse norm<=L0 sqrt N.

results.label: lem:row-counts
results.statement: Only a small fraction of original rows have atypical positive-sign counts.
conditions: rho,w fixed; probability exp(-Omega(n^2)); proof counts independent upper-triangle variables with multiplicity, not independent rows.

results.label: lem:prime-corank
results.statement: Biased bit models have simultaneous all-prime corank control when nonsingular.
conditions: Uniform p/b arrays with rank mean<=2; bound N^(3/5), group generators<=ceil(N^(3/5)); real singular case excluded.

results.label: thm:height-cover
results.statement: The companion low-height rank-distance cover is reused.
conditions: Fixed D,P; m<=N; cardinality2^(N^2 ell^-P); rank distance, not angles; companion source, not an independent new construction.

results.label: lem:minimizer
results.statement: The companion saturated determinant minimizer provides a stable quotient.
conditions: All sublattices in quotient satisfy det>=T^rank; existence, not efficient construction.

results.label: lem:projected-count
results.statement: An all-sublattice determinant bound makes projected short-point counts subexponential.
conditions: Scale T/[10(log j+2)], T=log^4 N, radius sqrt N; j<=N, rank zero countone; no determinant-only premise.

results.label: thm:small-intersection
results.statement: One typical biased matrix event controls all high-index intermediate lattice cosets.
conditions: Fixed D,alpha in(0,1), tau=ell^-D; nonsingular B and index>=N^(tau N) imply intersection<2^(alpha N), uniformly in p/b arrays; adaptivity allowed.

results.label: lem:separated-subsets
results.statement: Many projected coordinate subset sums remain separated modulo the scaled quotient lattice.
conditions: Uses the preceding constructed E,Lambda,S,C,R0; every integer 1<=abs(u)<=N^C; at least c1 tau N indices; not arbitrary lattice statement.

results.label: lem:dual-fourier-average
results.statement: Dual Gaussian averaging suppresses all bounded integer Fourier frequencies despite shifts.
conditions: The constructed dual law and hitting set J are required; any real shifts; expected squared characteristic product<=exp(-c3 tau N).

results.label: prop:static-column
results.statement: Small high-layer tail yields a subexponential admissible-column bound.
conditions: L0,e0 fixed then zeta; typical nonsingular bit B with W2<=zeta; not a determinant-only bound.

results.label: lem:pairing-colors
results.statement: The companion primary-coloring and restricted pairing-image inputs are reused.
conditions: Perfect discriminant pairing of nonsingular symmetric integer B; top exponents above third; restricted H-to-H dual image, not full-group dual.

results.label: lem:color-subgroup
results.statement: Each primary color lies in a subgroup with a second-layer-gap index bound.
conditions: Index at least l^(b_l2-b_l3); uses scaled pairing radical and isotropic subgroup, not all colors forming a partition by subgroups.

results.label: lem:color-cost
results.statement: Specifying selected colors costs sublinear bits with a height-two dichotomy.
conditions: T2 sums layers of height exactly2; if T2>=sigma choose primes reaching sigma with o(N) color cost, otherwise all colors cost o(N).

results.label: lem:robust-extraction
results.statement: An affine restriction makes a binary set robust with entropy loss at most rho m.
conditions: Nonempty set, rho>0; companion extraction input, not a new application algorithm.

results.label: lem:robust-image
results.statement: Robust short rational affine image differences have small covolume.
conditions: Fixed D,C0, rho=ell^-D; injective rational affine Phi and pairwise distance<=C0 sqrt N; rank zero determinantone.

results.label: lem:pairing-determinant
results.statement: The companion rational-form determinant bound uses one pairing-index factor.
conditions: Primitive radical K and orthogonal complement S; determinant>=detK^2/[t detL^2]; no squaring t.

results.label: lem:graph-comparison
results.statement: Admissible graphs have a size bound controlled by the high-layer pairing tail.
conditions: T2<sigma; all height<=exp(N ell^2) inverse bilinear restrictions lose<=xi N rank and at mostxi N small eigenvalues; output exponent2J_B+2xi+o1, for fixed L0,xi,w.

results.label: prop:inverse-rank
results.statement: One typical event controls inverse bilinear restriction ranks on low-height spaces.
conditions: Nonsingular B; D,xi fixed; all rational F with height<=exp(N ell^D); shifted symmetric-block proof, no uniform F2 basis invariance.

results.label: prop:small-spectrum
results.statement: Typical biased bit matrices have few eigenvalues near zero with exp(-cN^2) failure.
conditions: xi fixed; interval +/-w_xi sqrt N with p-dependent w; centered variance p(1-p) and rank-two mean; not a least-singular-value guarantee.

results.label: lem:path-deletion
results.statement: The companion one-or-gated-two principal deletion applies.
conditions: Both cross columns satisfy the stronger infinity norm<=1 and scalar bit gate; implies new l2 gate for L0>=1; empty minor included.

results.label: lem:path-algebra
results.statement: Companion retention lattices and excess-layer recursion apply to the biased path.
conditions: Retention only implies fixed-lattice membership; endpoint nonsingularity for recursion, widths1/2; specified positive layers and fixed quotient.

results.label: lem:path-retention-cost
results.statement: A costly extension costs one maximum-atom exponent, while a small-tail width-two gate costs two.
conditions: p_N=2^[-N(a-2e0)]; preceding-column conditioning retains fresh independence; smallW2 start required for gate bound p_N^2.

results.label: lem:path-dissociation
results.statement: An intermediate lattice constraint has a maximum-atom bound without typicality.
conditions: Nonsingular C, indexN^(qN), independent bits with max atom<=b; probability<=b^(2qN/3).

results.label: lem:path-heavy-cost
results.statement: Heavy retained layers cost 2^(-c_p qN) conditionally on valid previous exposure.
conditions: q>=eta/(100 log N), q<=1/2; eta,p fixed; start nonsingular and tested p/b bits independent; no destination conditioning.

results.label: lem:path-high-tail
results.statement: High-layer tails on the last window are exponentially unlikely along a fixed path.
conditions: Event A includes path gates/nonsingular nodes; fixed path, terminal5R window, bound2^[-Omega_p,eta(NR)]; backward existence is not an adaptive forward sampling law.

results.label: lem:path-window
results.statement: A deterministic terminal window needs two costly steps or a width-two small-tail gate.
conditions: 5R nonsingular gated steps, allW_R<=eta and terminalW2>zeta; large N; distinct costly events, not asserted independent.
